AI data companies

Profiles of 39 AI data companies. Each figure links to its source and shows when we checked or recorded it. Each profile lists any paid work we found. Two of the 39 are nonprofit research groups.

The guide is a selected study of the market. It does not list every company. Firms not yet profiled include Uber AI Solutions, TELUS Digital, CloudFactory, SuperAnnotate, Encord, Defined.ai, LXT and Welocalize.

AI & data services

11 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • A.TeamPlaces experienced engineering teams inside businesses to build and run AI systems that carry out work.
  • AppenUses people to prepare and check AI training data. Its work includes speech data and AI programs that act in the physical world.
  • APTOCreates AI training data with specialist workers and its harBest software.
  • G2iSupplies experienced engineers who build AI practice tasks and training data. Their work also includes AI testing.
  • iMerit / EXLCombines specialist workers and software to prepare AI training data and test AI systems.
  • Invisible TechnologiesCombines expert data and AI testing with software that helps businesses automate their work.
  • RWS / TrainAIPrepares AI training data in many languages. Specialists also review AI answers and test systems for harmful behavior.
  • SamaUses people to label and check training data. It also tests AI performance on image and other data.
  • Scale AIProvides expert training data and AI testing. It also builds AI applications for businesses and governments.
  • TaskUsRuns customer support and content safety services for other businesses. Its AI work supplies training data and tests AI systems.
  • TolokaUses specialist work to create training data and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.

AI training data & practice environments

10 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • AbundantBuilds simulated tasks and training data for AI programs that carry out work.
  • BenchFlowBuilds practice tasks and tests for AI programs that carry out work. It also provides tools to run those tests.
  • Bespoke LabsBuilds realistic practice tasks for AI programs that carry out work. Its tools help teams train and test those programs.
  • DatacurveRecruits experienced developers to create coding data and test AI coding tools.
  • LabelboxBuilds practice tasks and expert feedback for AI training. Its business software runs AI programs that carry out tasks.
  • Ooak DataTurns real business work into AI practice tasks while removing identifying details from the data.
  • PolymathBuilds simulated software tasks that train AI to complete extended engineering work.
  • ProximalTurns records of human and AI work into training data. Its tests measure AI performance on demanding technical tasks.
  • RefreshCreates software practice tasks for AI, including Blender (software for making and animating three-dimensional scenes).
  • Snorkel AIBuilds specialist training data and tools to test AI. It also creates practice tasks for AI systems.

Expert data & AI testing

9 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • AfterQueryTurns professional expertise into AI training data and practice tasks.
  • Handshake AIBrings professionals into AI training and testing work. Their expertise also shapes practice tasks for AI.
  • MercorConnects specialists with AI training and testing work. It also helps businesses put AI programs to work.
  • micro1Uses specialist knowledge to create AI training data and realistic practice tasks. It also tests how AI performs those tasks.
  • Pareto AIUses specialists’ judgment to create AI training data and tests.
  • ProlificConnects researchers and AI teams with verified participants who are paid to provide feedback.
  • Surge AIUses expert work to train and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.
  • TeracConnects verified specialists with paid research and AI training work.
  • TuringUses specialist knowledge to build AI training data and practice tasks. It also helps businesses use AI in their existing work.

AI testing & safety

3 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • Alinia AIBuilds software that checks business AI against company rules and legal requirements.
  • GiskardTests business AI software for security weaknesses and unreliable answers.
  • Trajectory Labs, PBCBuilds tests that look for harmful AI behavior. It also creates practice tasks for AI training.

AI software & analysis

2 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • HackerRank BenchSells software that tests developers’ skills. Its AI business also supplies coding data and practice tasks for AI.
  • QuesmaExamines how AI writes code to explain costs and find failures.

Computing & AI model research

2 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • ElorianResearches AI systems that reason from images about physical space and design.
  • Prime IntellectProvides computing resources and tools for teams that train and run their own AI systems.

Nonprofit research

2 companies · Open this group in the interactive list

  • AIXI LabsStudies the mathematics behind AI decision-making and ways to reduce AI risks.
  • Laude Institute / Terminal-BenchFunds public computing research and helps develop Terminal-Bench, which tests AI on practical computer tasks.
